other_text: THE BLOOD IN THE SNOW CANADIAN FILM FESTIVAL / FORGHT NIGHT / Playing with the World Premiere of "The House of Flies" / Saturday December 1st, 2012 6:30pm / Projection Booth 005 - 1035 Gerrard Street East / Festival pass $40. Individual tickets $13 / TANGORIA
